name: delegation-writer-crlf-exact-length
description: The brief is supplied with CRLF line endings. brief_chars must be the length of the brief as handed over (13 chars for 'alpha\r\nbeta\r\n'), so the read must not apply universal-newline translation -- Path.read_text() normalized CRLF to LF and recorded 11, understating every CRLF brief and, with it, the oversize advisory.
